text:
Arseny Gritsyuk, a 2019 fifth-round pick who came over from the KHL for last season, has 8 goals in 18 games. Yahoo Sports asked the right question: can he keep this pace for the Devils?

Our answer is not quite. He has 8 goals on 4.8 expected and is shooting 18%, against 9% last season, and New Jersey has scored 4.1 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. He has gone his last five games without a goal.

The good news is everything underneath. The Devils take 62.9% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice, and his own chances are up to 1.03 expected goals per 60 from 0.71 last season. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 54% of his entries, with 53% of his shots off the rush. Our season-end range is 21 to 34 goals. On 15.6 minutes a night, a cooling-off would still leave him a real scorer.
headline: Gritsyuk's scoring pace has a catch
